data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** c2c3a48de1d125c1dd44d773920d7e9d7ae54b73

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The ticket CLI accepts short ID prefixes (e.g. \`f61f-7e0a\`) and resolves them to the full canonical ID (\`f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d\`) for subcommands such as \`ticket show\` and \`ticket exists\`. The 8-char prefix is the form shown in user-facing listings (e.g. \`list-epics\` output groups them as \`f61f-7e0a\\tP*\\t<title>\`), and other subcommands (\`list-epics\`, \`transition\`, \`comment\`) appear to accept it. Consistent prefix resolution is implied by the \`ticket list-epics\` UX, the orchestrator's documented use of 8-char IDs throughout sprint Phase 1, and the way the sprint skill instructs users to \"Enter the number or epic ID to execute.\"

#### Actual Behavior

Running \`.claude/scripts/dso ticket show f61f-7e0a\` exits 1 with:

\`\`\`
Error: ticket \"f61f-7e0a\" has no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event
\`\`\`

\`.claude/scripts/dso ticket exists f61f-7e0a\` also exits 1 (no stdout). Both succeed when called with the full ID \`f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d\`.

### 3. Action History

1. User invoked \`/dso:sprint f61f-7e0a\`.
2. Sprint Phase 1 validation ran \`.claude/scripts/dso ticket show f61f-7e0a\` -> exit 1 with the error above.
3. Sprint Phase 1 fallback \`.claude/scripts/dso ticket exists f61f-7e0a\` -> exit 1.
4. User asked for in-progress epics list; \`ticket list-epics --all\` showed the matching epic with the 8-char form \`f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d\` (full ID is 16-char with two extra segments).
5. Re-running \`/dso:sprint f61f-7e0a-36d3-4e7d\` (full ID) resolves correctly.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Skill: \`/dso:sprint\` Phase 1 (Initialization & Primary Ticket Selection) — passes the user-supplied argument directly to \`ticket show\` without prefix resolution.
* Affected subcommands observed: \`ticket show\`, \`ticket exists\`.
data.title: [ticket CLI]: 8-char ID prefix passed to ticket show/exists -> command fails with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event error
